jobs.description:
About the Boerma Instituut

The Boerma Instituut was founded in 1980 by Theo and Jose Boerma and is currently led by Jacqueline Boerma, fourth generation of a family with more than 120 years of experience in floral design.

The school offers foundation courses, international programmes, workshops, masterclasses and the Master Florist programme (Meesterbinder). Our mission is to train students from all over the world to become professional florists and floral designers.

Position

As a Floral Design Instructor, you will teach classical and modern floral design, guide international students and represent the school abroad. The role includes teaching in the Netherlands as well as international travel.

Responsibilities

- Teach International Vocational, Advanced and Master Florist programmes, levels 1 to 3
- Teach hand-tied bouquet courses and floral courses for funerals, weddings and events
- Provide private lessons and group training
- Prepare lessons, order materials and create sample pieces
- Coach and mentor students
- Support competitions, events and open days
- Travel internationally to teach and demonstrate on behalf of the school

Requirements

- Master Florist Diploma (Meesterbinder) with transcript
- Average grade of 8 or international equivalent
- Transcript must be submitted
- Knowledge of the Golden Ratio, proportion, Fibonacci composition and asymmetrical floral design
- Teaching experience at Master Florist level is required
- Extensive portfolio of own work; the portfolio must be submitted before the interview
- Knowledge of colour theory and correct nomenclature of flowers, plants and materials
- Willingness to learn Dutch
- English is currently the working language
- Minimum of 10 years of professional floral design experience
- Minimum of 3 years of teaching or training experience
- Experience with international competitions and demonstrations
- Valid category B driving licence
- Strong artistic vision, technical skills, pedagogical skills and flexibility to travel internationally

SSAB Services, Hardox Wearparts is a rapidly growing business unit with ambitious targets. As Business & Technical Development Manager for Hardox Wearparts you will be an integral part of building and implementing a new business model. 

You will participate in the development and conceptualization of the new business model, including the future product and service mix as well as the go-to market setup. Placement is optional.

Responsibilities include

•Business concept: Conceptualization and structuring of existing knowledge in order to define the  service offer

•Product and service portfolio evaluation and definition

•Development of trainings and manuals

•Piloting the new concept, preparing for future concept sales

•Mapping end user needs to ensure concept success

You will report to the Head of Hardox Wearparts Concept Management.

Your qualifications
To be successful in this role you need to have a master degree in engineering or equivalent. 

We believe that you have at least 5 years experience of working with wear products and/or maintenance in the one of the aggregates industries. You have strong social skills and experience from successfully driving and implementing development. 

You have a curious mind and strong analytical skills paired with good technical understanding of wear in practice (maintenance and wear products). As a lot of the future development will have a strong connection to digital tools and systems development, you need an overall understanding of the possibilities that exist within digital development. 

You are fluent in English and thrive in an international environment where global contacts are part of the every day work. Speaking Dutch is a plus as the position wil be based in the Netherlands.

As a person you are positive and interested in new ideas - and in making them happen. 

We offer
You will be part of, and have the possibility to grow within, an international and dynamic organization that is developing rapidly. Hardox Wearparts has ambitious growth targets and as a vital member of the development team, you will contribute to our future success. 

Application
Send your application no later than 20th of March 2019

For more information, please contact
Nancy Matos, Manager Hardox Wearparts Concept, phone +46 155 255 422

For our client, an international company specialized in the management, maintenance and rental of Ground Support Equipment (GSE) for the aviation industry, we are looking for a experienced motivated Welder / Mechanical Assembler. 

As a Welder / Mechanical Assembler, you will be responsible for carrying out welding and metal fabrication work, as well as repairing mechanical components of non-motorized Ground Support Equipment (GSE). You will ensure that all work is performed safely, efficiently and in accordance with technical specifications and quality standards.

Your Responsibilities 

 

 
• Perform welding work using MIG, TIG, stick (electrode) welding and other welding techniques on GSE equipment. 
 

 
• Repair cracks, reinforce structures and manufacture custom metal components. 
 

 
• Assemble and install mechanical parts and components. 
 

 
• Install, adjust and maintain hydraulic and pneumatic systems. 
 

 
• Read and interpret technical drawings and engineering plans. 
 

 
• Carry out inspections and preventive maintenance on welded structures and mechanical components. 
 

 
• Repair and maintain locks, locking mechanisms and other mechanical systems. 
 

 
• Inspect completed work to ensure quality standards are met and provide technical support to colleagues when required. 
 

 
• Properly use and maintain welding equipment, tools and workshop machinery. 
 

 
• Comply with all health, safety and quality procedures. 
 

 
• Record completed work, repairs and material usage accurately. 
 
•  
Work closely with colleagues from the mechanical, electrical and workshop departments to ensure efficient maintenance and repair operations.

 
• You have at least 5 years of experience as a welder and/or mechanical assembler, preferably within the aviation, automotive or heavy industrial sector. 
 

 
• You have a solid knowledge of MIG, TIG and stick (electrode) welding techniques. 
 

 
• You have experience with metal fabrication, construction work and mechanical assembly. 
 

 
• You can confidently read and interpret technical drawings and blueprints. 
 

 
• You understand the properties of different materials and their behaviour during welding and repair work. 
 

 
• You are accurate, quality-driven and committed to working safely. 
 

 
• You are a reliable team player with a strong sense of responsibility. 
 

 
• You have a good command of the English language. 
 

 
• You hold a valid Category B driving licence. 
 
•  
A forklift certificate is considered an advantage. 

 
• You are willing to obtain an airport security badge and airport driving permit.

You will be the analytical engine behind our clients' most challenging impurity investigations. You will design and execute highly sensitive mass spectrometry methods to ensure the safety and compliance of pharmaceutical products.
 
 

• Design, develop and validate sensitive and robust analytical methods for trace-level analysis quantification (with a primary focus on nitrosamine and NDSRI’s) using LC-MS/MS and HRMS, in compliance with ICH, FDA, and EMA guidelines.  

• Perform complex sample preparation and analysis in diverse pharmaceutical matrices, applying expertise in mass spectrometry (Triple Quadrupole, HRMS), chromatographic separation (UHPLC) and sample preparation.  

• Design robust extraction and sample clean-up strategies (e.g., SPE, liquid-liquid extraction) to overcome severe matrix effects in complex drug products, while strictly preventing artifact generation during analysis. 

• Conduct and support root cause investigations related to impurity formation, focusing on chemical pathways, impurity profiling, and risk assessment across drug substance and drug product development.  

• Deliver data and reports according to high scientific and quality standards. Contribute to method transfer and GMP documentation.  

• Promote innovation by exploring novel analytical approaches and emerging technologies to enhance detection limits and method robustness.  

• Support lab operations in full compliance with GMP and data integrity standards.  

• Interact with our clients to discuss scientific aspects.
  

• Represent Anabiotec/anacura in internal and external scientific forums and scientific conferences. 
 

• PhD in Analytical Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biochemistry (or a closely) related scientific field) or Master degree with at least 6 years of relevant industry experience.  

• Minimum of 4–6 years of hands-on experience in pharmaceutical R&D or analytical services.  

• Proven experience in LC-MS trace analysis in drug substances, drug products, or excipients is a strong asset.  

• Extensive practical knowledge of mass spectrometry (QqQ and orbitrap) and chromatography.  

• Experience in method development, validation, and transfer under GMP conditions.  

• Familiarity with regulatory requirements (ICH Q2, Q3, FDA/EMA guidance on nitrosamines) and GMP principles.  

• Excellent English communication skills (written and spoken) is required for high-quality scientific reporting. 

• Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a dynamic laboratory environment to project timelines.  

• Capable of prioritizing tasks across multiple urgent client projects in a dynamic CRO environment.

• Involved in the (bio)-pharmaceutical drug development process of our clients. 

• Responsible for the development of complex LC-MS/MS methods for small molecules, proteins and/or oligonucleotides.  

• Operate & maintain LC-MS/MS and HRMS instrumentation, incl. routine performance checks, calibration and (basic) troubleshooting. You act as a subject matter expert on Mass Spectrometry. 

• Support the introduction, qualification and transfer of new MS technologies and analytical workflows. 

• Support lab operations in full compliance with GMP and data integrity standards.  

• You deliver data and reports according to high scientific and quality standards and interact with our clients to discuss scientific aspects. 
  
 

• PhD (or Master equivalent by experience) in a scientific field with a strong (technical) focus on mass spectrometry. 

• Extensive hands-on experience with LC-MS operation and troubleshooting on high resolution mass spectrometry platforms (ideally combined triple quad MS platforms) is essential. 

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work on complex analytical investigations, using a systematic root-cause approach to distinguish LC-, MS-, sample- and method-related issues.  

• Experience with a variety of chromatographic separations (e.g. RP-LC, HILIC) and/or nanoflow liquid chromatography is an additional asset. 

• Capable of working to the highest quality standards required to support development, qualification and validation of LC-MS based methods. 

• Proven ability to work in a dynamic laboratory environment to project timelines.  

• Excellent organization and communication skills in English. Knowledge of Dutch is an asset.

jobs.description:
Are you looking for a varied and challenging job in the logistics sector? GXO Logistics in Mechelen is looking for motivated Forklift Drivers to strengthen our team! 

As an all-round operative, you will be involved in various steps of the logistics process. 

Your tasks may include: 

 
• Checking, packing, labeling, and preparing products for shipment 
 

 
• Performing customized tasks according to customer specifications (customization) 
 

 
• Scanning and registering goods in the WMS system 
 

 
• Administrative processing in Excel and Word 
 

 
• Moving goods using EPT, stacker, or forklift 
 

 
• Reporting deviations and results to the team leader 
 

 
• Assisting with inventories and stock checks 
 

 
• Ensuring a clean and safe workplace 

What are we looking for in you? 

 
• You understand and speak Dutch or English fluently 
 

 
• You have experience operating EPT, stacker, and forklift 
 

 
• You have a valid certification for forklift. 
 
• You are familiar with WMS systems, scanners, Excel, and Word 
 

 
• You work accurately, are organized, and have an eye for detail 
 

 
• You are a team player but can also work independently 
 

 
• You have at least 1 year of experience in a logistics or production environment 
 
•  
You are physically able to lift heavier objects

 

 
• You are willing to work in a 2-shift system: 

Early shift: 6:00 AM – 2:00 PM Late shift: 2:00 PM – 10:00 PM 

OR in a night shift system:

10:00 PM - 06:00 AM

It is possible that you will be asked to work on weekends as well, so some availability and flexibility are required.

For an international manufacturing company in the Aalst region, we are looking for a Maintenance Technician to work in a 2-shift system. You will help ensure the optimal operation of an advanced machinery and equipment park, while having the opportunity to further develop your technical skills.
 

You will work in a 2-shift system from 06:00 to 14:00 and from 14:00 to 22:00.
 

Your tasks and responsibilities
 

 
• As a Maintenance Technician, you will be responsible for maintaining, repairing and improving industrial machinery and technical installations. Thanks to your technical expertise, you will help keep production processes reliable and minimise downtime.
 
• Carrying out preventive maintenance on production machines, injection moulding machines and auxiliary equipment.
 
• Troubleshooting and resolving electrical, mechanical, hydraulic and pneumatic faults.
 
• Carrying out corrective repairs in the event of technical failures.
 
• Analysing faults and identifying sustainable solutions.
 
• Independently carrying out small technical projects and improvements.
 
• Actively contributing to optimisations aimed at increasing the reliability and efficiency of the machinery.
 
• Working closely with the production department to minimise downtime.
 
• Working in accordance with applicable safety, quality and environmental standards.
 
• Contributing to a clean, safe and orderly working environment. 

 
• You have a technical degree in Electromechanics, Electricity, Automation or a similar technical field. Relevant practical experience can also be considered.
 
• You have experience in maintaining and repairing industrial machinery.
 
• You have knowledge of preventive and corrective maintenance in a production environment.
 
• Basic knowledge of PLC controls is an advantage. If you have limited experience in this area, you will have the opportunity to learn and develop your skills internally.
 
• Experience with injection moulding machines is an advantage, but not a requirement.
 
• You have a good command of Dutch.
 
• You are able to understand technical documentation in English and/or German.
 
• You have strong analytical skills and a solution-oriented approach.
 
• You have a hands-on mentality and a strong sense of responsibility.
 
• You enjoy working as part of a team, while also being able to carry out technical interventions independently.
